package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"runtime"
	"runtime/pprof"
	"time"

	_ "example.com/scaling/design"
	"github.com/CaliLuke/loom/codegen/generator"
	"github.com/CaliLuke/loom/eval"
	"github.com/CaliLuke/loom/expr"
)

func main() {
	start := time.Now()
	if err := expr.RegisterDefaultRoots(); err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	if err := eval.RunDSL(); err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	outputs, err := generator.Generate(".", "gen", "example.com/scaling/design", false)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	var m runtime.MemStats
	runtime.ReadMemStats(&m)
	if _, err := fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "MEASURE files=%d elapsed=%s total_alloc=%d heap_alloc=%d heap_inuse=%d num_gc=%d\n", len(outputs), time.Since(start), m.TotalAlloc, m.HeapAlloc, m.HeapInuse, m.NumGC); err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	f, err := os.Create(os.Args[1])
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	if err := pprof.Lookup("allocs").WriteTo(f, 0); err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	if err := f.Close(); err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
}
